introHtml: Gray adds a neutral, sophisticated touch to promotional toys, games, and party supplies. Whether you are planning a company picnic or a trade show giveaway, gray items like custom puzzles, playing cards, or party favors offer a subtle alternative to bright colors. They pair well with any logo and appeal to a broad audience. Decorate with screen printing or full-color imprint for a clean, professional look.
